description: What a hub answers on a document socket when it refuses a Commands batch for a TRANSIENT reason: `ApplyOutcome::Rejected` whose `messages` hold exactly `answer` (a `HubTransientApplyRefusalMessageV1`, `🚧️refusal/🧬️schema`), so the client keeps the batch and resends it. `causes` are the transient refusals the hub has (the db engine could not admit the batch now; the document socket's command budget is empty until it refills; the sender's agent command rate is paced out), each with the reason the hub reports. `permanentCauses` are refusals that carry NO transient message (resending cannot help). `invalidMessages` are near misses a client must not treat as the transient refusal (Ajv oracle).
